title: 第41章 座谈会的交锋
content_zh:
第41章 座谈会的交锋-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》
上一章
存书签
下一章
座谈会一开始，主编胡琦便引入了“宏观”和“个体”之争，刻意营造出来了极为浓郁的辩论氛围。但是目光环视一圈，会发现氛围其实还挺轻松，在座每个人脸上都带着淡淡的笑容。
胡琦本来想结束发言，见场面氛围营造得不够，不得不继续发言，将新中国军旅文学的发展脉络梳理了一遍。
“同志们，我的发言完毕，现在有请《归队》作者刘济民同志发言。”刘济民同志是来自43军的一名普通战士，因救人立过二等功，目前正在医学科学院读书。
人虽然年轻，但是出手不凡。他的《五十万颗心的碰撞》在《光明日报》发表之后，引发了国内青年人关于‘人生观’的大讨论。
同时，青年人的思想问题开始引起社会各界的关注。刘济民随后又在《解放军文艺》发表长达九万字的中篇小说《童年的朋友》，这是他第一次在文坛崭露头角。
他的小说让许多从革命年代走过来的老同志，想起了少年、青年时期的朋友，他对战火中的童年、友情、爱情的描写感动了许多读者。”
胡琦看了一眼刘济民，继续笑着说道：“同志们，九万字啊，在座的各位第一次写作，能写九万字的不多吧？如果说《童年的朋友》证明了刘济民同志在文学创作方面的天赋，那么《归队》的热销，则证明了刘济民同志还是一个能源源不断、持续创作的天才青年作家。
下面，先让济民同志讲讲自己的创作思路吧。”
胡琦说完，带头鼓起了掌，会议室的气氛热烈了起来，众人的目光都落在刘济民身上，有赞赏，也有好奇，还有审视。
刘济民起身敬了一个标准的军礼，接着坐下开始自己的讲话：“各位首长、文坛前辈，编辑同志，首先感谢大家能够出席《归队》座谈会。
诸位文坛前辈能够出席我这个文坛年轻人的作品座谈会，我内心受到了极大的鼓舞。
《归队》创作的背景，我在接受采访的时候讲过，东北抗联在抗日战争中是打得最久、处境最艰难、最悲惨、最壮烈的一支队伍。杨靖宇烈士以枯草、树皮、棉絮充饥，鏖战五日，战斗到最后一刻。

Chapter 41 Confrontation at the symposium - "Literary Heroes 1978: Beginning as a Military Writer"

At the beginning of the symposium, editor-in-chief Hu Qi introduced the debate between "macro" and "individual", deliberately creating a very rich debate atmosphere. But looking around, you will find that the atmosphere is actually quite relaxed, and everyone here has a faint smile on their face.
Hu Qi originally wanted to end his speech, but seeing that the atmosphere of the scene was not created enough, he had to continue speaking and sorted out the development of military literature in New China.
"Comrades, I have finished my speech. Now I would like to invite Comrade Liu Jimin, the author of "Return to the Army" to speak." Comrade Liu Jimin is an ordinary soldier from the 43rd Army. He has achieved second-class merit for saving people and is currently studying at the Academy of Medical Sciences.
Although he is young, his skills are extraordinary. After his "The Collision of Five Hundred Thousand Hearts" was published in Guangming Daily, it triggered a great discussion among young people in China about their 'outlook on life'.
At the same time, the ideological problems of young people have begun to attract attention from all walks of life. Liu Jimin then published a 90,000-word novella "Childhood Friends" in "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art". This was the first time he made a name for himself in the literary world.
His novels reminded many old comrades who came from the revolutionary era of their friends in their youth and youth. His descriptions of childhood, friendship, and love during the war moved many readers. "
Hu Qi glanced at Liu Jimin and continued to say with a smile: "Comrades, 90,000 words. It is your first time writing. Not many of you here can write 90,000 words, right? If "Childhood Friends" proves Comrade Liu Jimin's talent in literary creation, then the popularity of "Returning to the Team" proves that Comrade Liu Jimin is still a talented young writer with endless energy and continuous creation.
Next, let Comrade Jimin talk about his creative ideas. "
After Hu Qi finished speaking, he took the lead in applauding, and the atmosphere in the conference room became heated. Everyone's eyes fell on Liu Jimin, with admiration, curiosity, and scrutiny.
Liu Jimin stood up and saluted a standard military salute, then sat down and began his speech: "Dear leaders, literary seniors, and editor comrades, first of all, thank you all for attending the "Return to the Army" symposium.
I am greatly encouraged by the fact that all seniors in the literary world can attend the symposium on the works of a young man like me.
The background of the creation of "Return to the Team", I said in an interview that the Northeast Anti-Japanese Anti-Japanese Federation was the team that fought the longest, was in the most difficult situation, the most tragic, and the most heroic during the Anti-Japanese War. Martyr Yang Jingyu ate grass, bark, and cotton wool to satisfy his hunger, and fought fiercely for five days until the last moment.
